transitionRules: DISCOVERED->BYTE-VERIFIED requires exact full SHA-256 and physical identity
BYTE-VERIFIED->MEMBER-INDEXED requires exact non-overflowing byte span and member SHA-256
MEMBER-INDEXED->IMPORTED-PROVENANCE-ONLY grants zero authority and zero closure transfer
IMPORTED-PROVENANCE-ONLY->TYPED-SUPERSEDED requires one literal old atom, one replacement atom and non-weakening proof

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: response loss may yield COMMITTED-UNCONFIRMED as an immutable terminal
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: Response loss appends RESPONSE-LOST and moves the Attempt to non-final UNCERTAIN; exactly one immutable FinalizationRecord is created only after authoritative reconciliation.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: Response loss never proves absence; the Attempt cannot retry or grant authority while uncertain.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: The replacement preserves one-use, no-retry and zero-authority while removing only the contradiction between terminal immutability and later reconciliation.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: COMMITTED-UNCONFIRMED is one of the exact terminals
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: COMMITTED-UNCONFIRMED becomes OutcomeObservation=RESPONSE-LOST plus AttemptState=UNCERTAIN; it is not FinalResult.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: Unknown commit state grants zero usable authority and freezes dependent Acts.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: FinalResult remains immutable; uncertainty is strictly safer because it cannot become authority until a fenced readback resolves it.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: every response-loss case yields one terminal before reconciliation
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: Every response-loss case yields one non-final uncertainty observation and later exactly one immutable final result.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: No false absence, replay or concurrent retry is permitted.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: The replacement adds a monotonic observation layer and retains exactly-one-finalization.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: terminal mutation forbidden applies to labels that included uncertainty/quarantine
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: Terminal mutation remains forbidden for FinalResult; UNCERTAIN and QUARANTINED are AttemptState values and may transition only through explicit ordered reconciliation guards.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: No final authority result can be overwritten or duplicated.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: State movement is append-only and ends in exactly one immutable FinalizationRecord.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: authoritative SourceReferenceIndex entry includes an absolute path
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: Authoritative identity is repository-root-relative logicalPath + full SHA-256 + byte span; an absolute resolver mapping may exist only in private non-authoritative local observation and is never a Public package member.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: The exact bytes, locator and physical identity remain independently resolvable.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: Two clean workspaces must resolve the same root while machine-local identity disclosure becomes impossible in the Public package.

typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: G1/G2 cannot issue GenesisPermit or OperationalPermit; each may instantiate and consume only ConformancePermit with usableAuthority=0 and capabilityBits=0 through the byte-identical permit reducer.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: G1/G2 never become Current, bootstrap a Definition or reach an external target.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: The separate type exercises the exact logic without creating operational authority.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: only a later accepted operational Instance can issue Permit
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: Only a later independently accepted operational Instance can issue OperationalPermit; ConformancePermit is a zero-authority test input, not an issued authority object.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: Operational Permit issuance remains impossible before accepted B0.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: The type distinction prevents recursive authority and preserves operational parity.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: G1/G2 conformance objects cannot issue Permits
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: G1/G2 cannot issue authority-bearing Permits; they may instantiate a sealed ConformancePermit whose authority and capability bits are structurally zero.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: No conformance generation grants authority or effects.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: The conformance object is not a Permit authority edge and cannot be promoted or converted.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: closed role universe omits Approver and contains seven roles
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: Closed work-role universe is AuthorityOwner, Producer, QA, Reviewer1, Reviewer2, Reconciler, Approver, AcceptanceWriter.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: Every approval remains authenticated, scoped, current and controller-separated.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: Adding Approver restores the imported role and increases the prohibited-pair denominator from 21 to 28.

typedSupersessions.oldAtom: complete seven-role matrix has 21 prohibited pairs
typedSupersessions.replacementAtom: Complete eight-role matrix has all 28 unordered pairs explicitly prohibited from sharing an EffectiveController.
typedSupersessions.preservedSafetyIntent: No Producer, QA, reviewer, reconciler, approver, writer or authority owner can manufacture an independent act.
typedSupersessions.nonWeakeningProof: The stronger denominator preserves all former 21 prohibitions and adds the seven missing Approver pairs.

roleUniverse.approverSemantics: Approver is a distinct appointed work role; exact Tal AuthorityOwner approval is a separate mandatory receipt; neither substitutes for the other.

generationProtocol.g1: ConformancePermit;exact reducer/CAS/revocation path;capability sink;usableAuthority=0;cannot become Current
generationProtocol.g2: Fresh ConformancePermit;fresh roots;exact reducer/CAS/revocation path;capability sink;usableAuthority=0;cannot become Current
generationProtocol.o1: Only after accepted Definition and external OperationalPermit;cannot bootstrap Definition
generationProtocol.o2: Fresh operational generation proving replay/revocation/invalidation after O1;cannot retroactively validate G1/G2
